method.table: Gray<60 connected components, area4..140px and width/height2..17px; fixed unobstructed left-table ROIs; nearest right-hand neighbor with dx10..55px and abs(dy)<8px; median Euclidean adjacent-hole spacing and image row angle.
method.mat: Mean grayscale scanline y460..464; subtract Gaussian31x1 local background; local maxima above6gray levels in x250..435; this clear strip excludes mat edges, packet and gripper.

limits: Fixed image regions compare projected local scale; they are not registered physical landmarks or a plane homography.
